component.name: Fast Math
component.summary: Practice mental arithmetic against the clock

description.p: Fast Math is a game to train your mental arithmetic. Pick the operations you want to practice, choose a level and answer up to 60 questions before the time runs out.

Choose any combination of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, and mix them in the same round. Pick one of five levels and set the time limit, which is two minutes by default. Type each answer and press Enter. At the end you see how many answers you got right and how fast you were, and the best scores are kept in a leaderboard.
The comparison mode asks whether a number is less than, equal to or greater than another. Compare whole numbers, decimals like 8.3 and 8.25, or calculations, alone or mixed.

ul.li: Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, alone or mixed in the same round
Five levels, from small numbers up to sums of 1000 and tables of 20
Rounds of up to 60 questions with a configurable time limit, two minutes by default
Sound effects and music, which can be turned off from the menu
A leaderboard with the best scores for each combination of operations, level and time limit
